pages: Day 127: More men have joined us. Hired men, the kind who carry crossbows and do not ask what for, and the kind who carry axes and ask even less. He pays them in nothing. They look at Him the way I used to, and I cannot tell them what that look will cost.

He has begun to keep some of the bodies. Not the sick ones. The strong ones, the ones that fought. The men carry them behind the column on carts, under cloth, and at night He sits with them and whispers, and in the morning there is one fewer on the cart and one more walking at the back.

There is a hill outside every village now. He has the men build it the same way every time, a frame of beams and a drop. He says a thing that is seen is a thing that is believed. I have stopped asking what He means.
